country_decisions: CFG-INT-001: authorized cross-institution exchanges and contract versions (exchange relationships and the integration's purposes, approved by two officials; none ship).
CFG-DAT-001: retention and disclosure of the exchange log and receipts.

library.title: Return the permitted tax-status result
library.intro: The tax authority's answer: registered or not, active or not, and for which taxes; nothing under tax secrecy.
library.filled_by: The tax authority, through its exchange service.
library.authority: The tax authority named for the tax slot answers through the taxpayer.status exchange service; never a ministry by name.

deviations.what: A status response, not a case: the exchange service answers at once and logs the request with a signed receipt
deviations.why: A verification decides nothing; the owning institution's register is the authoritative record.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: the twin and checks never create authoritative facts; lib/exchange/services.ts callService()

deviations.what: Between two institutions the service answers only while an approved exchange relationship in force covers it and the purpose stated; a suspended, ended or expired relationship stops the next call at once
deviations.why: Specification Part 5 E and L test 5: a revoked relationship stops new exchanges while preserving prior records.
deviations.rule: lib/federation/binding.ts exchangeBinding() in lib/exchange/services.ts callService() (plan I9)

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

library.intended: Answered by the taxpayer.status exchange service with a signed receipt; no case is opened.

en.length: The signed receipt (its id) is too long.

hint.en: Recorded by the platform when the form is received.
